note: Published gap-composition fractions per benchmark would explain UDA's notorious inconsistency in one table; component interactions (own note) are the technical fight but even a first-order decomposition is field-useful.

Materials-vs-geometry attribution has partial precedent in photorealism-for-detection studies; the factor-crossed hybrid rendering design is cleaner than prior work but the conclusion may just confirm the field's suspicion.

'Night robustness research is partly chasing vendor ISP artifacts' is a sharp attribution claim; RAW night data with GT is the scarce ingredient, and the vendor-varying recovered fraction is the headline figure.

Tripod-locked cross-device benchmarking is honest instrumentation of an unbenchmarked axis; alignment-tolerant metrics are a real methodological wrinkle and cross-camera robustness notes exist scattered in prior work.

When-TTA-helps-vs-harms has been mapped by the TTA-pitfalls line (ICML 2023 era) including statistics-adaptation failure under label shift; the channel-statistics pre-test is an increment on a published map.
The stuff-style vs thing-novelty bimodal mechanism is a plausible and testable structure for geographic shift; continuous mixture attribution (own note) is the right correction to its own overclaim.
Transfer maps + gated adaptation is method engineering downstream of 0226/0231's science; if those decompositions land, this becomes their obvious application section.

Super-additive weather interactions with a physics-predicted worst-case map turns robustness testing from enumeration into prediction; sparse natural coverage of combination cells is the honest limitation.

Geometry-mediated invariance with a computable mixing ratio is a decent tradeoff study; depth-for-robustness intuitions circulate widely and the depth estimator's own shift sensitivity may eat the effect.

Predictive-validity benchmarking of shift measures for DENSE tasks is a genuine gap (the classification version - accuracy-on-the-line, ATC - is well developed, which both helps and crowds it); the 30-pair assembly is the real work.
Hysteresis framing is elegant and the anchor-replay fix is testable; continual-TTA drift (CoTTA line) already documents error accumulation, so the return-gap formalization is the specific new asset.

'Adaptation methods get credit for learning label conventions' is a devastating possibility testable with 300 re-annotations; if the >25% figure holds for even one canonical pair, every UDA table needs a footnote.

A dimensionless resolution-shift law with a computable resizing rule is practical measurement science; multi-resolution training grids are compute-real and the per-family split (own note) may fragment the law.

'Recompress your deployment inputs to match training statistics' is the kind of inverted prescription that gets cited for a decade if true; the experiment is nearly free and the signed per-class effect is decisive either way.

Data-vs-objective credit assignment is the ecosystem's biggest question, but public checkpoint ladders confound exactly the factors being separated (own note); without matched reruns the answer stays correlational, and matched reruns are expensive.

Unsupervised accuracy estimation is mature for classification and emerging for segmentation; the per-pixel forecasting benchmark with structured forecast errors is the defensible slice, but the space is filling fast.

Natural worst-case mining transplants the natural-adversarial-examples program to dense prediction; the proxy-mines-proxy-artifacts risk (own note) is serious and spot annotation is the non-negotiable control.

Time-of-day as an anti-causal prior is a clean shortcut hypothesis with a probe+intervention design; relighting realism gates the causal leg, and it competes with 0199 (context hallucination) for the same conceptual slot.

The itemized signed ledger for synthetic data (with class-selective mixing validation) is immediately actionable for practitioners; two-simulator replication requirement is right and doubles the budget.

Cross-pair rank-stability audit of UDA with frozen hyperparameters; the classification reality-check genre exists (Musgrave-style), which strengthens the method and narrows the novelty to segmentation + rank-stability framing. Lit-attacked below.
Metric-geometry conditioning as the unexploited shift-invariant channel is plausible; the honest scope note (ground-plane-anchored classes only) shrinks it to a solid but narrow study.

Variance-matched randomization would replace grid search with measurement - genuinely useful if the law is clean; per-factor sweep training grids are expensive and joint-optimum shifts (own note) may break the marginal story.

Making the amplitude-method ceiling explicit (FDA's blind spot) is a well-aimed follow-up to a famous paper; the linear-systems framing is admittedly first-order but the class-structured residual is a real finding if stable.

Reference-quality asymmetry inflating measured domain gaps, with a no-reannotation diagnostic, converts a suspicion into an instrument; survey-then-reannotate protocol (own note) is exactly the right design.

Geometry-first beats learning-first for geometrically-caused shift is a satisfying David-vs-Goliath comparison; homography viewpoint augmentation is not new per se, so the head-to-head against UDA methods is the paper.
